prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone portrait 2:3 illustration, 1024x1536, for jieqi.dev Chinese seasonal greeting card; one complete image, not a collage.
Primary request: 冬至 sweet series.
Scene and seasonal subjects: a warm bowl of dumplings beside a low winter sun and long soft shadows; shortest day, family warmth.
Style and composition: Wholesome cute sweet-girl anime storybook illustration matching the approved 白露 girl: original girl with large expressive eyes, softly wavy brown hair and small bow, modest long-sleeved high-neck knee-length dress with lace trim, opaque tights and flat shoes; adapt outfit warmth and pastel colors to season, fully clothed everyday innocent styling. Natural cheerful full-body pose holding or interacting with one appropriate seasonal object. Ordinary human proportions with gently enlarged cartoon head, no fantasy ears or object-shaped hat. Fine clean anime linework, luminous soft shading, ivory, blush and seasonal pastel palette. Generous ivory background with sparse seasonal framing; girl lower two thirds and clear dark sage horizontal Chinese title at top. No revealing clothing or mature posing.
Text (verbatim): "冬至". Exactly these 2 correct simplified Chinese characters only, complete readable print-quality strokes, no invented forms. Keep title well inside canvas.
Avoid: any other text, English, numbers, dates, captions, poems, signatures, logos, watermark, postal marks, stamp borders, perforated edges, UI screenshots, photorealism, 3D, cropped main subject or feet.
Dumpling requirement: unmistakable Chinese jiaozi with curved half-moon crescent silhouette and pinched seams along one curved edge. NO round buns, NO baozi, NO xiaolongbao. Serve on a plate or in soup.
